name: teleqna_stats_1xA100_Sep2026
_note: Per-cluster training statistics for the TeleQnA four-model pool, measured on 1 x A100 at concurrency 32 under vLLM 0.19.0, the basis the paper reports. NOTHING is Pareto-dominated here and the sweep has six regions; on the submitted 2 x A100 configuration Gemma4-E2B and Gemma4-E4B were pruned and it had three. Reproduce lambda* with: cre fit --stats configs/teleqna_stats.json --budget 20
